title: Satellite operators are in panic mode due to a worsening launch crisis
summary: Across the pond, United Launch Alliance sought to end its dependence on Russian engines for the Atlas V rocket by migrating to the new Vulcan rocket. Even before these two rockets reached the launch pad, their launch manifests were booked up.
